summary: Phase H Part A · Multi-Account Management (iter-137). Backend + frontend fully verified. 14/14 pytest cases pass (overview shape, per-account entries, floating identity, equity-curve series length for 7/30/90 days, days clamp low/high, PATCH empty payload/label/bogus-id validation, PATCH group+trading_enabled with GET verification, restore-all, list-still-works). Frontend interactions verified end-to-end: MultiAccountOverview panel + aggregate-stats-bar renders (6 accounts), all 6 stat testids present, period pills 7/30/90 switch, toggle-per-account-lines flips, per-card trading-toggle flips state & persists after reload, group-badge opens window.prompt and applies/clears group. Global AccountSwitcher renders on dashboard AND /accounts, panel opens with 6 rows + 6 toggles + MANAGE ACCOUNTS footer, clicking a row navigates to /bot-config?account=<id> (URL cleaned by BotConfig via setSearchParams — verified account is selected in UI), switcher-toggle updates DB via PATCH (confirmed via API), toast surfaces on toggle. All accounts restored to trading_enabled=True and group='' at the end (verified via API).

issues: Recharts warns 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' during initial mount before container measures — cosmetic only, chart renders correctly after first paint. Consider giving ResponsiveContainer a minHeight/minWidth to suppress.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning by adding minHeight/minWidth to ResponsiveContainer in MultiAccountOverview.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: account_routes.py update_account correctly rejects empty payload (400), empty label (400) and other-user's account (404). Response goes through _serialize so `_id` is never leaked.

bot_runner._connected_accounts filters `trading_enabled: {$ne: False}` — treats missing field as enabled (correct default). Per-account cfg branch (line ~287) blocks with clear pulse message 'Trading is DISABLED on this account'. Enforcement path is airtight.
MultiAccountOverview hides itself for users with < 2 accounts (line 48) — intentional per PRD. Correct.
AccountSwitcher polls /accounts/overview every 30s and on mount. Uses close-on-outside-click + panel remains open on toggle. Solid pattern.
editGroup uses window.prompt — noted as design choice; works reliably in Playwright with dialog handler. If a nicer modal is desired later, keep the same data-testid.
equity-curve series length exactly equals `days` param (inclusive of today) — matches PRD.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing 6 admin accounts. All trading_enabled/group state restored to defaults at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter137_multi_account.py — self-contained, uses cookie session auth, cleans up its own state. Frontend flows verified: MultiAccountOverview (only renders with >=2 accounts), AccountSwitcher (in QuickActionsBar, present on every page including dashboard), per-card trading-toggle and group-badge on /accounts. Group edit relies on native window.prompt — Playwright needs page.on('dialog', handler). URL after clicking a switcher row is /bot-config (BotConfig strips the ?account query param via setSearchParams after reading it — that's expected behavior, not a bug).
